title: Include current-page group counts in follow-up Excel export
description: A salesperson exporting a grouped follow-up reminder page receives selected detail worksheet plus a separate current-page group-count worksheet. Reuse bounded reauthorized Excel preview and scoped group metadata. GroupBy none keeps one sheet; grouped mode shows group key, label and count with explicit empty-page note. Never recalculate from all records or expose unselected columns. Preserve formula-safe text and typed dates/numbers. Existing HTTP operation logging audits export. Development only: no schema or migration changes, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused workbook tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Grouped Excel export reruns authorization and bounded preview, writes selected current-page details and group counts; none retains one worksheet.
Group worksheet has only scoped current-page counts and an empty-page note; detail order, typed values and formula safety remain intact.
Workbook tests cover grouped/ungrouped sheets, revocation, empty pages and formula text; safe Release build/test passes.
